claim_scope.cohort_terminology: Job-D-disjoint, prospectively frozen replication cohort drawn outcome-blindly from a previously constructed battery. It is participant/video/frame/donor disjoint relative to Job D but must not be described as globally untouched, independently held out, or study-wide held out.

data.selection_rule: retain every source frame pair whose participant cluster, source video, source frame, and donor identities are all absent from the complete Job D cohort

decision_rule.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over exactly two one-sided participant-cluster bootstrap p-values
decision_rule.positive_cell: Late p=(1+count(delta_late_bootstrap<=0.10))/(B+1); early p=(1+count(delta_early_bootstrap>=-0.10))/(B+1). Each elementary test passes at Holm-adjusted p<0.05. The 0.10 recovery-unit threshold is inside the null, not a post-hoc point-estimate screen.

terminal_taxonomy.gemma_late_superiority_only: G1 passes but G2 does not; the late component-complement advantage replicates at the registered materiality threshold, while an endpoint reversal does not.
terminal_taxonomy.gemma_reversal_confirmed_component_conce: G1 and G2 pass; early and late point estimates have the registered opposite signs; one component has at least half of total positive Shapley allocation and a positive descriptive 95 percent interval. If that component is Q, P, or R, its single-component recovery must also exceed all four registered same-size crop controls. This is position-set concentration, not unique mediation.
terminal_taxonomy.gemma_reversal_confirmed_distributed_or_: G1 and G2 pass with the registered opposite endpoint signs, but no component satisfies the frozen concentration rule.
terminal_taxonomy.not_replicated: G1 does not pass. Report estimates and intervals without an automatic follow-up experiment.
terminal_taxonomy.no_scientific_result: Any mandatory token partition, hook, closure, cache, label-firewall, telemetry, or exact-inventory gate fails. This is a technical failure requiring repair, not a terminal scientific category.

component_codes.Q: exact literal user-prompt token subsequence positions
component_codes.R: every active non-frame position not assigned to C, Q, or P

factorial.cardinality_benchmarks: At Gemma L34 only, for each nonempty nonvisual group Q/P/R, four deterministic same-cardinality samples are drawn without replacement within each sample from C using SHA-256 ordering keyed by seed, model, group, replicate, and the frozen position map. They are descriptive crop-token cardinality benchmarks, not negative controls or specificity tests.
factorial.gemma_early_operators: At L22 run only full-frame F, complete non-frame complement K=C union Q union P union R, and full active sequence A.
factorial.gemma_late_operators: At L34 run all 15 nonempty unions of C/Q/P/R, full-frame F, full active sequence A, and the 12 descriptive cardinality benchmarks.
factorial.qwen_operators: At both L24 and L36 run full-frame F, actual complete non-frame complement K=active minus F, and full active sequence A. Record whether K equals C as a technical geometry result; never substitute C for K.
factorial.shapley: For Gemma at L34, v(S) is recovery for the union S of C/Q/P/R and v(empty)=0 by the unpatched-recipient definition. Four-component Shapley values are computed exactly from all 16 set values and sum to v(CQPR). All 15 nonempty Mobius coefficients are also frozen descriptive outputs.
factorial.structurally_absent_groups: The all-request canary must prove nonempty, invariant C/Q/P/R position maps for Gemma. Qwen does not require separate C/Q/P/R cells because its registered operator is the actual complete complement K.

outcome.statistical_unit: participant cluster after averaging its two counterbalanced orders

primary_estimands.G1_gemma_late_complete_complement_minus_: At Gemma L34, delta_late=rho(K)-rho(F), with equal weight over corruptions and directions inside each participant cluster; test H0: delta_late<=0.10.
primary_estimands.G2_gemma_early_full_frame_minus_complete: At Gemma L22, delta_early=rho(K)-rho(F), with equal weight over corruptions and directions inside each participant cluster; test H0: delta_early>=-0.10.
primary_estimands.ordering_reversal: Confirmed only when both Holm-controlled elementary tests pass. The depth interaction delta_late-delta_early is reported descriptively with its participant bootstrap interval.
primary_estimands.qwen_secondary: At Qwen L24 and L36 report rho(K)-rho(F) and the endpoint interaction descriptively; these are outside the two-test primary family.

statistics.factorial_interaction_summary: At Gemma L34, exact Mobius coefficients for all nonempty C/Q/P/R subsets and exact four-player Shapley values are recomputed jointly inside every participant-cluster bootstrap resample.
statistics.shapley_interpretation: descriptive allocation of the measured set function, not proof of semantic or mechanistic mediation

technical_gates.all_request_geometry_preflight: Before any production outcome, every one of 92 public requests is prepared for both models and all three arms. Active masks, input and position IDs where present, image-slot spans, exact literal Q and appended P boundaries, next scored answer token, donor-recipient alignment, component fingerprints, and empty-group status must pass. Gemma C/Q/P/R hashes and counts must be invariant across all rows.
technical_gates.component_partition: F/C/Q/P/R must be disjoint and exactly partition every active position; K is active minus F and equals C union Q union P union R
technical_gates.gpu_memory: every model/operator canary remains below 76 GiB peak allocated CUDA memory on an 80 GiB H100
technical_gates.hook_contract: every expected hook fires exactly once, changes only its selected positions, receives shape-compatible finite donor state, and is removed
technical_gates.label_firewall: worker-visible trees contain no evaluator row or hidden artifact; selected hidden rows are staged only after all worker and technical gates pass
technical_gates.cardinality_benchmark_contract: same-cardinality crop benchmarks are deterministic, unique by position hash within group, subsets of C, satisfy group size <= C size, and never replace a factorial cell
technical_gates.model_cache: exact pinned offline revisions and weight files exist before workers launch
technical_gates.source_identity_disjointness: selected participant, video, frame, and donor identity overlap counts against Job D are all exactly zero
